description: Triaged baseline of known static-audit findings. The regression gate (run_repo_audit --baseline <this file>) exits non-zero only on P0/P1 findings whose (severity, code, path) signature is NOT present here. Pre-existing findings are grandfathered; the gate fails closed on regressions (new P0/P1). To accept new findings after triage, re-run with --update-baseline.
policy: Grandfather pre-existing findings; fail closed on new P0/P1.
